description: Land Acquisition - Paragahakele west, Ampara D/S Division, Ampara District - Amendment to the notice published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1838/58 of 29.11.2013 by D/S Division, Ambalantota
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains specific notices about government acquisition of land for public usage, including detailed descriptions of land lots, their locations, boundaries, and procedures for ownership claims and compensation. This fits squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it focuses exclusively on land-related administrative matters.
